label: Forge

projection.consumedFor: canonical cluster status, skills, resolving membership, exact task demand, assignment-evidence state, and typed gaps

lifecycleBoundary: Deferred and archived lifecycle are unavailable until canonically projected.

derivation.clusters: one canonical card per exact clusterId; duplicate winners compare explicit scene fields with code-unit ordering
derivation.membership: eligibleAgentIds only when each ID resolves to a canonical agent
derivation.demand: exact requires-cluster task-to-cluster edges with both endpoints present
derivation.assignmentEvidence: recorded/unknown state from bounded redacted canonical sourceRef presence; raw sourceRef and evidence payloads never render
derivation.gaps: exact cluster/task subject IDs only; unmappable typed gaps render once unscoped

noReverseInference: Never infer deferred or archived lifecycle from inactive status, IDs, labels, sourceRef, gaps, fixtures, or successRate. Inactive remains inactive.

density.overflow: fail closed or render a bounded explicit unknown/truncated state

authority.governedActions: Proposal flow deferred to Task 11; telemetry may inform a future governed proposal but never triggers an automatic action

browserParity: FORGE_BROWSER_JS is explicit browser-valid source composed into the single boot IIFE; Node and browser observable HTML is byte-identical
redaction: Every projection-derived value is bounded and escaped. Secret grammar covers query_id=, auth_date=, word-boundary hash=, Bearer whitespace, bot_token, clientSecret, initData, TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA, TG_INIT_DATA, QUESTS_PUSH_TOKEN, token=, PRIVATE KEY, prompt assignment, and prompt injection. Raw source/evidence payloads, digests, credentials, Telegram auth, private client data, and hostile raw IDs never render.
